messages:
maya: Quick async scrub for Q2 milestone orbit — 3 min ask: what actually shipped, what slipped, and explicit next-step owners. Drop short lines + PR/issue refs.

alex: Shipped — routing v2 canary (PR #3245), embeddings cache enabled for search flows. Verified perf numbers in dashboard.

tj: Slipped — autoscale policy work blocked by infra quota. ETA moved to next sprint. Raised infra ticket INF-902.

priya: FYI code-review backlog: 4 open reviews blocking rollout: #3245 (alex), #3281 (luca), #3300 (sophie), #3312 (me). If owners can ping reviewers we can unblock.

luca: PR #3281 is a small config change, waiting on CI flake repro. Will re-run tomorrow morning and add a note.

sophie: #3300 needs an API ok from product for the param name. @maya can you confirm we want `max_prefetch` vs `prefetch_limit`?

maya: prefer `prefetch_limit` for consistency with other SDKs — go with that.

alex: For rollout plan, after #3245 merges we'll canary 10% for 24h, then 50% for 6h, then full. I can own canary ops after merge.

tj: Infra update — INF-902 asked for quota bump, SRE responded: need usage projection and spike test plan. I can draft the projection if product+eng own test plan.

priya: I can write the test plan (load profile + token distribution). Assigning test plan to @priya, projection to @tj, and SRE follow-up to @luca.

maya: Owner confirmations: alex (canary ops), priya (test plan), tj (quota projection), luca (SRE follow-up), sophie (API param change). Please reply with :thumbsup: when done or a 1-line blocker.

alex: :thumbsup: will do ops and watch metrics.

priya: :thumbsup: writing test plan now, will add to QA board and link here when ready.

tj: :thumbsup: starting projection doc, will attach to INF-902 in an hour.

luca: :thumbsup: I’ll chase SRE and follow up on CI flake.

sophie: small API note: changing param name will require a short SDK bump — I can land it alongside #3300.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: routing-v2-canary -> cluster-a at 2026-04-05T09:00Z (triggered by alex).

maya: Thanks all. Quick next steps summary — I’ll consolidate into the milestone checklist: 1) merge PRs (#3245, #3281, #3300, #3312) 2) execute canary (alex) 3) run spike tests (priya+tj) 4) confirm quota bump (luca). If anyone hits a blocker tag me.

alex: One more note — tagging reviewers: @sre-team, @runtime to speed approvals.

priya: Link to temp test-plan draft once I finish: will post back here.

maya: Closing check-in for async — will post consolidated checklist in the milestone board by EOD. Thanks everyone.
